title: {{NAME}} and the Princess Dinosaur Soccer Tournament
moral: Playing your best and being kind matters more than winning.

pages.content: {{NAME}} arrived at a grand castle soccer field. The goals were made of gold. The seats were full of dinosaurs wearing tiny crowns. A princess in a soccer kit stood in the centre. She wore a shiny tiara and cleats. She was the captain of the Royal Dinosaur Soccer Team.
